note: The language-qualified heading Subject headings, French was not given geographic subdivision; since Subject headings may be subdivided geographically, catalogers should post-coordinate Subject headings--[place] with Subject headings, [language] for works on subject headings in a given language and region.
The subdivision --Interviews was added to the free-floating lists for classes of persons (H 1100), ethnic groups (H 1103), corporate bodies (H 1105) and individual persons (H 1110).
The subdivisions --Doctrines--History were added to the free-floating list for religions (H 1185).
France--Foreign relations--1995- already covers the period, so France--Foreign relations--21st century is not made as a heading; it is a UF of the existing heading.

headings: Monasticism and religious orders for women
note: Because the multiple subdivision --Anglican Communion, [Lutheran Church, etc.] exists under Monasticism and religious orders for women, the base heading is subdivided by denomination, e.g. Monasticism and religious orders for women--Coptic Church, rather than creating a new heading.
Headings of the form [Topic A] and [Topic B] (SHM H 310) are not combined with phrases such as in literature, in art or in motion pictures; separate headings for each concept are assigned instead.

The phrase in literature is not used with 'and' headings designating a reciprocal relationship between two topics (e.g. Children and death in literature); assign two separate headings such as Children in literature and Death in literature.
The subdivision --Philosophy is free-floating under topical headings, so a proposal to establish Cuban literature--Philosophy was unnecessary.

Urban Indians is handled with Indians of [...]--Urban residence--[place] and/or Indians of North America--[place] (e.g. Indians of North America--Arizona--Phoenix); the subdivision --Urban residence is established for use under many individual tribes, and a separate heading Urban Indians was not approved.
The subdivision --Christian authors was added to the free-floating list for literatures (H 1156).
The subdivision --Vocational education (May Subd Geog) was added to the free-floating lists for classes of persons (H 1100) and ethnic groups (H 1103).
The subdivision --History and criticism is free-floating under music form headings, so a proposal for Boleros (Music)--History and criticism was unnecessary.

Headings for fires in individual buildings are formulated with the free-floating subdivision --Fire, [date] under the building heading (e.g. Richmond Theater (Richmond, Va.)--Fire, 1811) rather than as a separate heading for the fire.
Islands of the ... headings are established only for island groups in oceans and seas, not gulfs; for islands in a gulf use Islands--[country]--[gulf], e.g. Islands--Mexico--Gulf of California.

A chronological subdivision such as Estonia--History--1200-1561 must express a generally recognized period of the place's history as shown by standard reference sources, not a period drawn from a book chapter title.
The subdivision --Calvinist authors was added to the free-floating list for literatures (H 1156).
[Topic] in ... phrase headings are not made for individual genres of literature; the general pattern [Topic] in literature is used instead (e.g. Astronomy in literature).
The heading Composers is not qualified by nationality adjectives (no Composers, Armenian); local subdivision is used instead, e.g. Composers--Armenia.

LC will not begin establishing the subdivisions --Reporting or --Monitoring under individual crimes (e.g. Gays--Violence against--Monitoring); post-coordinate headings such as Human rights monitoring or Citizen crime reporting with the crime heading.

SHM H 1647 sec. 6 on period subdivisions under philosophy headings will be revised to cover uninverted headings of the type [name of religion] philosophy (e.g. Jewish philosophy) as well as inverted headings.
Works on New France continue to receive Canada--History--To 1763 (New France) and/or Mississippi River Valley--History--To 1803 rather than a separate New France--History heading.
The subdivisions --Larvae--Color and --Sex ratio were added to the free-floating list for animals (H 1147).

The free-floating subdivision --Fingering under musical instruments (H 1161) includes the concept of positions, so Guitar--Fingering is used instead of Guitar--Positions; the existing Violin--Positions and Violoncello--Instruction and study--Positions were cancelled.
The subdivisions --Seedlings--Effect of flooding on (May Subd Geog) were added to the free-floating list for plants and crops (H 1180).
The subdivision --Uzbek influences was added to the free-floating list for literatures (H 1156).

The subdivision --European influences is free-floating under headings for literary genres (H 1156), so a proposal for Chinese poetry--European influences was unnecessary; SHM H 1675 will be revised to clarify this.
The subdivision --Law and legislation is not used under headings for individual crimes.
Headings of the form [individual species] culture are not established; post-coordinate a general heading (e.g. Shrimp culture) with the heading for the specific organism.

The subdivisions --Climatic factors and --Catch effort are not established under headings for fisheries of individual species; use a general fishery heading with the subdivision post-coordinated with the species fishery, and existing species-level headings with these subdivisions will be cancelled.

In the qualifier of a river heading, counties are sequenced starting with the county where the river originates, and GNIS lists the mouth first and source last; Richland Creek was changed to (Greene County and Monroe County, Ind.).
American drama--20th century--Collections and --21st century--Collections conflict with SHM H 1425 and H 1780 and were not approved.
Proposals to change the form subdivisions --Officers' handbooks and --Soldiers' handbooks were deferred pending the ALA SAC Genre/Form Implementation Subcommittee's review of form subdivisions.

Goal setting in the sense of strategic planning is expressed with the subdivision --Planning under the topic (Municipal government--Planning), not with a heading like Goal setting in municipal government.
A proposal to change the form subdivision --Petty officers' handbooks was deferred pending the ALA SAC Genre/Form Implementation Subcommittee's review of form subdivisions.

The 15th century is not a generally recognized period in the history of accounting or public finance, so use the free-floating --History--To 1500 rather than a new chronological subdivision such as --History--15th century.
Photography, Artistic is Not Subd Geog; a recent change to May Subd Geog was a mistake and was reversed.

Headings for exercise for special classes of persons are made only when the exercise itself differs substantially for the group and are not made by educational level; otherwise use Exercise for children or a similar heading with a heading for the class.
The subdivisions --Motors (Diesel)--Exhaust systems were added to the free-floating list for land vehicles (H 1109).

LC will not establish --Catch effort or --Limited entry licenses under headings for individual species fisheries; use a general fishery heading with the subdivision post-coordinated with the species fishery, and existing species-level headings will be cancelled.
Authors, Arab may be subdivided geographically, which suffices; no nationality-specific headings or references such as Authors, Saudi Arabian are made for each country.
LC does not wish to establish the pattern [planetary feature]--Geological mapping; post-coordinate the feature heading with Geological mapping.

Headings in the form [topic] and [topic] are for relationships between two very general topics treated broadly from both perspectives (SHM H 310); other works are cataloged by post-coordinating the two topic headings, e.g. Religion and Cognitive science.
College orations is not qualified by nationality and LC will not start doing so; post-coordinate College orations with Speeches, addresses, etc., American.

The free-floating subdivision --Tomb may be used under names of individual persons (H 1110), e.g. Mama Hatun, Queen of Erzurum, d. ca. 1201--Tomb, rather than establishing a separate heading for the tomb.
The subdivision --Selecting and serving has never been used in LCSH and LC will not establish it (e.g. Wine--Selecting and serving).

patterns: [Sport or class of institution] qualified by type of institution
note: LCSH does not qualify headings for individual sports or kinds of schools by type of institution or ethnic group (e.g. College football, African American private universities and colleges); post-coordinate the separate headings.
The subdivision --Food was not added to the list of topical subdivisions under classes of persons (H 1100); it may be proposed for use under a specific heading if needed.
The subdivision --Morale was not added to the pattern subdivision list for military services (H 1159); assign the military branch heading together with Military morale instead.
Blue crab fisheries--Research--Law and legislation was not approved; post-coordinate Blue crab fisheries with Fisheries--Research--Law and legislation.
